canonical_title: Verify that provisions are incorporated to (a) prevent actuation following activation and subsequent relief of safety devices, (b) provide for locking of folding wings, blades, or other surfaces in the folded/stowed position, and (c) ensure locks are positive and do not depend on any power source to remain engaged.
